caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical object composed primarily of wood and metal. The base and the central body appear to be constructed from light brown wooden planks, showing grain texture and vertical seams where the boards join. Two rust-colored metal bands encircle the wooden part at the top and bottom. Attached to the upper metal section is a large metal gear mechanism with interlocking teeth; a long, slender metal handle extends diagonally downward and to the left from this gear. The top of the device features an upright, forked metal piece with a flat, T-shaped end. The entire object has a weathered, aged appearance, with the metal portions showing prominent rust and wear. The drawing uses a muted earth-toned color palette, emphasizing shades of brown, gray, and rust. The background is plain, off-white, and untextured, with a fine single-line border and a small inscription in the lower right corner.
title: Wagon Jack
